normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “Mirasol Blue”, a serene coastal retreat designed for rest and restoration in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach. Just a 2-minute walk to the sugar-white sands and emerald waters of the Gulf, this beautifully curated 1 Bed, 1.5 Bath escape is perfect for solo travelers or couples seeking a peaceful 30A getaway. Light-filled interiors, calming coastal design and thoughtful details create an atmosphere of quiet luxury where guests can truly unwind. Enjoy slow mornings with coffee on the private balcony overlooking the Gulf, relaxed evenings by the firepit on the patio and effortless days exploring scenic 30A with the two included bikes. With a chef’s kitchen, cozy living area with an electric fireplace and a spacious king suite with a workspace, “Mirasol Blue” offers a refined coastal experience designed to help you slow down, reconnect and leave feeling refreshed. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Sleeps 2 with 1 Bedroom + 1.5 Baths: Perfectly designed for couples or solo travelers seeking a peaceful 30A retreatPrime Blue Mountain Beach Location: Just a 2-minute walk to the beach and steps from beloved local restaurants, cafés and shopsPrivate Balcony with Gulf Views: Enjoy slow mornings, coastal breezes and sunset skies from your own peaceful retreatCalming Coastal Design: Light-filled interiors thoughtfully styled to create a relaxing and restorative atmosphereOutdoor Patio with Firepit and Grill: Relax under the stars with cozy seating and effortless evenings outdoorsChef’s Kitchen with Wine Cooler: Beautifully equipped kitchen ideal for preparing relaxed coastal meals2 Bikes Included: Cruise the scenic 30A bike path and explore nearby beach towns with ease*** LIVING AREAS ***The main living space at “Mirasol Blue” is warm, inviting and designed for relaxation. Natural light fills the room while soft coastal tones and comfortable furnishings create a tranquil setting that feels instantly calming. Whether you're enjoying a quiet morning with coffee or unwinding after a beach walk, this space invites you to slow down and savor the moment.Cozy living area with ample seating and flat-screen TVElectric fireplace creating a warm coastal ambianceOpen-concept design connecting living, dining and kitchen spaces*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The thoughtfully designed kitchen is both beautiful and functional, offering everything needed for relaxed coastal meals or an intimate dinner after a day by the beach. Generous counter space, stainless steel appliances and a built-in wine cooler make cooking and entertaining effortless.Spacious kitchen with stainless steel appliances and wine coolerAmple counter space for preparing meals with easeDining area with seating for 5 perfect for slow breakfasts and relaxed dinners*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Outdoor living is an essential part of the “Mirasol Blue” experience. Enjoy the peaceful Gulf breeze from your private balcony or gather on the patio below for an evening around the firepit. Whether it's morning coffee, sunset cocktails or a quiet night under the stars, these outdoor spaces are designed to help you fully embrace the beauty of Blue Mountain Beach.Private balcony with Gulf views and al fresco dining for 2Separate stair access from balcony to the 1st-floor patioPatio with gas grill and gas firepit with seating for 4Perfect setting for quiet mornings, sunset dining and starlit evenings*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With a thoughtfully designed layout, “Mirasol Blue" provides a peaceful retreat where comfort and privacy take center stage. The spacious primary suite offers a relaxing place to rest and recharge after days spent exploring 30A.1st FloorConvenient powder room and stacked washer and dryer located just off the kitchen2nd FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony access, dedicated workspace with monitor and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach, “Mirasol Blue” places you steps from some of 30A’s favorite local spots while still offering a relaxed coastal atmosphere. Walk to cafés and restaurants, browse charming shops or bike along scenic 30A to explore nearby beach communities.Beach Access: Just a 2-minute walk to the sugar-white sand and emerald Gulf watersBlue Mountain Creamery: Only a 4-minute walk for the area’s famous homemade ice creamBlue Mountain Beach Favorites: Walk to Red Fish Taco, Cowgirl Kitchen, The Shops at Blue Mountain Beach and For the Health of It. Grayton Beach State Park is also a short bike ride away for trails, dune lakes and kayaking*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to access the 2 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesThere is an active camera over the stairs facing the fire pit on the front patioPlease be advised that there is active construction across the street. At this time, we do not have a completion date.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
